app.navigation.hint: More features appear once you are granted access.
app.signOut.failedBody: We could not sign you out. Please try again.
auth.brand.title: Internal HR management
auth.brand.featureApprovals: Submit requests and track two-step approval
auth.brand.featureLeave: See your annual leave and timesheet
auth.brand.featurePrivacy: Everyone sees only the data they are allowed to
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.intro: Use the Google account HR registered for you.
auth.login.callbackFailedBody: Your Google sign-in expired or the account has not been granted access. Please try again or contact HR.
auth.activate.title: Activate your account
auth.activate.intro: Activate with your Google account. Each code can be used only once.
auth.activate.rejected: The activation code is invalid or has expired. Contact HR for a new code.
auth.activate.tokenDescription: Filled in for you when you open the activation link.
auth.activate.tokenInvalid: The activation code is not in the expected format
session.checkFailedBody: We could not check your session. Please try again.
home.title: Overview
home.accountReadyBody: Requests, annual leave and timesheets will appear here once HR links your employee profile.
home.rolesBody: The menu on the left shows only the features you have been granted. If something you need is missing, contact HR.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link does not exist or you are not allowed to view this page.
locale.label: Language
hr.write.deniedBody: Changes to identity data, leave rates, team assignments and the work calendar need two-step verification within the last 5 minutes. Set up two-step verification on the Sign-in methods page, then try again. If it still fails, you do not have permission — contact HR.
hr.write.unknown: The outcome is unknown because the connection failed. Reload the page to check before trying again.
hr.write.conflict: The information duplicates another record, no longer fits the current state or was just changed by someone else. Reload the page, check and try again.
employee.list.title: Employees
employee.list.description: Employees you are allowed to see.
employee.create.title: Add an employee profile
employee.edit.title: Edit basic information
employee.field.codeHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; up to 32 characters.
employee.field.annualLeaveHint: At least 12 days, in steps of 0.25 day.
employee.form.codeInvalid: Use letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen (up to 32 characters).
employee.form.documentNumberInvalid: The document number has 6–20 capital letters or digits.
employee.form.documentPair: Fill in both the document type and number, or leave both empty.
employee.form.taxCodeInvalid: The tax code has 10–13 digits, optionally followed by "-" and 3 digits.
employee.form.phoneInvalid: Phone must be 10–11 digits starting with 0 (or +84); spaces, dots and hyphens are allowed.
employee.form.emailInvalid: Work email is not valid (up to 254 characters; ASCII letters, digits, . _ + -).
employee.form.leaveDaysInvalid: Annual leave is 12 to 366 days, in steps of 0.25 day.
employee.profile.title: Basic information
employee.profile.untilHint: Each period ends the day before the date in the last column.
employee.status.effectiveOnHint: From this day the employee is permanent; before it, still on probation.
employee.status.effectiveOnFuture: This date is in the future: until then the employee stays on probation. Check it if you meant to confirm now.
employee.status.terminatedOnHint: The last day the employee works. This cannot be undone here.
employee.identity.title: Identity information
employee.identity.optionalHint: Can be added later. Only the employee and HR can see it.
employee.identity.freshHint: Saving identity information needs a sign-in from the last 5 minutes.
employee.leaveRate.title: Annual leave rate
employee.leaveRate.addHint: The new rate applies from its effective date; earlier rates stay in the history.
employee.leaveRate.probationNote: The annual leave rate starts when the employee becomes permanent.
employee.account.title: Sign-in account
employee.account.hint: Link the profile to an account whose email was added. You cannot link your own account.
team.title: Teams
team.description: Teams you belong to or may see, with their lead and members.
team.field.name: Team name
team.lead.title: Team lead (first approval)
team.lead.memberHint: Choose among the members of this team.
team.member.title: Members
team.member.empty: The team has no members yet.
team.member.removeLeadHint: The team lead cannot leave the team. Assign another lead or remove the lead first.
team.member.primaryHint: Each employee has exactly one primary team (the first team always is). A primary team can only be removed when it is the last one.
account.title: Sign-in methods
account.intro: Your email, the Google account you sign in with and your two-step verification.
account.summary.title: Your account
account.google.title: Google account
account.google.change: Each HRM account uses exactly one Google account. To switch to another Google account, contact your system administrator.
error.invalidRequest: The submitted information is not valid. Please check it and try again.
error.authenticationFailed: Your session is invalid or has expired. Please sign in again.
error.accessDenied: This action could not be completed. Reload the page or contact HR.
error.conflict: The data has just changed. Please reload and try again.
error.dateOutOfRange: A date of the request is outside the allowed range: from 7 days before to 90 days after today.
error.crossesYear: A request cannot run into the next year. Please split it into two requests.
error.kindNotAllowedInProbation: During probation you can only submit late arrival, early departure or unpaid leave requests.
error.teamNotMember: You are not in the chosen team or have no primary team yet. Please contact HR.
error.nonWorkingDay: The request has a day that is not a working day (weekend or holiday). Please pick another day.
error.makeupDay: Leave cannot be requested by shift on a makeup workday. Please pick another day.
error.idempotencyKeyReused: The request differs from the previous attempt. Please reload the page and submit again.
error.overlappingRequest: The request overlaps another of your requests that is pending or approved. Check your request list.
error.insufficientLeave: You do not have enough annual leave for this request (counted from the leave accrued to the end of the month of the day off, including requests waiting for approval). Choose another day or contact HR.
error.periodClosed: HR has closed this month's timesheet, so requests, final approvals and calendar changes for days in it are not possible. Please contact HR.
error.wfhLimitAckRequired: Approving this request takes the employee past 4 WFH days this month. Confirm you saw the warning, then approve again.
error.exportTooLarge: This report has more rows than one file can hold. Narrow the range and export again.
error.unavailable: The system is temporarily not responding. Please try again later.
leave.title: Annual leave
leave.description: Leave granted, used, approved for later days and waiting for approval as of the report date.
leave.entitledHint: Leave accrued to the end of the month of the report date.
leave.usedHint: Approved, days off up to the report date.
leave.futureHint: Approved, days off after the report date.
leave.pendingHint: Not counted as used until the final approval.
leave.availableHint: Granted minus used, approved for later days and waiting; never below zero.
hr.write.deniedBodyMfa: Changes to identity data, leave rates, team assignments and the work calendar need two-step verification within the last 5 minutes. Enter your code, then try again. If it still fails, you do not have permission — contact HR.
mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) confirms important actions.
mfa.setup.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key below.
mfa.setup.qr: QR code to add HRM to your authenticator app
mfa.setup.codeHint: Enter the code your app shows. The setup expires after 15 minutes.
mfa.setup.otherSessions: Once it is on, your other signed-in sessions are signed out.
mfa.setup.failedTitle: Two-step verification is not on yet
mfa.setup.rejected: The code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and enter a new code.
mfa.setup.expired: The setup expired or was finished elsewhere. Start again.
mfa.codes.title: Recovery codes
mfa.codes.body: Each code works once, for when you do not have your phone. They are shown only now — keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.remove.title: Turn off two-step verification?
mfa.remove.body: The app code and every recovery code stop working, and your other sessions are signed out. You cannot do important actions until you set it up again. This needs two-step verification within the last 5 minutes.
mfa.stepUp.title: Enter your verification code
mfa.stepUp.body: This action needs verification within the last 5 minutes. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.stepUp.recoveryBody: Enter one recovery code. A used code cannot be used again.
mfa.stepUp.rejected: The code is not valid or was already used. Too many wrong codes in a row sign you out everywhere.
mfa.stepUp.notEnabled: Two-step verification is not on for this account.
mfa.stepUp.done: Verified. Repeat the action within 5 minutes.
mfa.invalidRecovery: A recovery code has 16 characters: letters A–Z and digits 2–7.
calendar.title: Work calendar
calendar.description: Standard working hours, public holidays with full pay and makeup workdays.
calendar.standard.title: Standard working hours
calendar.standard.rest: The 13:00–14:00 lunch break is not working time. Saturday and Sunday are weekly days off, except makeup workdays.
calendar.holidays.title: Paid public holidays
calendar.holidays.empty: No public holiday in this year yet.
calendar.holidays.dayCount: Holiday days to apply (excluding Saturday and Sunday)
calendar.holidays.name: Holiday name
calendar.holidays.addHint: Enter the date range from the official public holiday announcement for the year; Saturdays and Sundays inside it are skipped. Each applied day creates a new calendar version.
calendar.form.dateInvalid: Enter a valid date as dd/mm/yyyy.
calendar.form.weekend: The range only has Saturday and Sunday; pick a range with at least one day from Monday to Friday.
calendar.form.rangeOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date.
calendar.form.rangeTooLong: The range can be at most 31 days.
calendar.form.nameRequired: Enter the holiday name (up to 200 characters).
calendar.makeup.title: Makeup workdays
calendar.makeup.description: A Saturday or Sunday worked as a full day, with the same hours 09:00–13:00 and 14:00–18:00.
calendar.makeup.empty: No makeup workday in this year yet.
calendar.makeup.addHint: Choose the Saturday or Sunday that will be a full workday, as announced by the company. Each change creates a new calendar version.
calendar.form.weekday: Makeup workdays can only be set on Saturday or Sunday.
request.list.title: My requests
request.list.description: The requests you have submitted and where each one stands.
request.list.empty: You have not submitted any request yet.
request.form.title: New request
request.form.description: Choose the request type and fill in the details. The system checks everything again when you submit.
request.form.slotHint: The 09:00–18:00 slot is a full day off and does not count the lunch hour.
request.form.conflict: The data just changed or this request cannot be processed yet. Reload your request list and try again.
request.form.unknown: The result is unknown because the connection was lost. You can press Submit request again: the system will not create a duplicate.
request.wfhLimitWarning: Request sent. Note: this month is or will be over 4 WFH days; the final approver must confirm the warning before approving.
request.form.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 1000 characters.
request.detail.title: Request details
request.systemReason.leadSkipped: The submitter is the team lead, so the team lead step was skipped.
request.systemReason.cooSelfApproved: The submitter is the COO, so final approval was automatic.
approval.inbox.title: Request approvals
approval.inbox.description: Requests waiting for your decision, oldest first; the Decided tab lists requests already decided within your approval scope, latest decision first. The system checks your permission again when you approve or reject.
approval.queue.empty: No requests are waiting for you.
approval.dialog.title: Review request
approval.decision.conflict: The request has just changed or was already decided. Its details were reloaded; review them and try again.
approval.decision.unknown: The result is unknown because the connection was lost. You can try again: the decision is not recorded twice.
approval.wfhAck.label: I saw the warning: approving this request goes past 4 WFH days this month.
approval.done.forwarded: First step approved. The request moves to final approval.
attendance.title: Timesheet
attendance.description: Scheduled working time of the month, computed from final-approved requests. Full time by default; unpaid leave, annual leave, WFH, late arrival and early departure are only recorded once a request is approved.
attendance.monthHint: Leave empty to see this month.
attendance.scheduledHint: Working days of the calendar while you are employed, nothing deducted yet.
attendance.paidHint: Scheduled time minus unpaid leave, plus paid holidays.
attendance.holidayHint: Public holidays and Tet in the month: paid in full, not counted as working time.
attendance.annualHint: Annual-leave requests with final approval; they do not reduce paid time.
attendance.wfhHint: WFH days with final approval; still a full working day.
attendance.lateHint: Only the number of times and minutes are recorded, nothing is deducted.
attendance.earlyHint: Only the number of times and minutes are recorded, nothing is deducted.
attendance.adjustmentHint: Paid minutes HR added or subtracted this month; already included in the paid time.
request.cancel.title: Cancel request
request.cancel.bodyPending: A request waiting for approval becomes cancelled. This cannot be undone.
request.cancel.bodyApproved: An approved request is reversed: leave is given back, timesheet and WFH count are removed, no new approval is needed. Not possible once the month's timesheet is closed.
request.cancel.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for cancelling an approved request.
attendance.period.title: Close timesheet month
attendance.period.description: HR closes the timesheet month by month. A closed month takes no requests, final approvals, cancellations of approved requests or calendar changes for days in it; reopening needs a reason and is recorded.
attendance.period.closeBody: Closing stores the timesheet of every employee for the month. Afterwards no request or calendar change can alter this month.
attendance.period.reopenBody: Reopening allows changes to the month's requests and calendar; the stored timesheet is dropped and the month must be closed again.
attendance.period.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for reopening the month.
attendance.period.noHistory: This month has not been closed or reopened yet.
attendance.period.conflict: This month changed state or cannot be closed yet (not started, already closed or already open). The state shown has been reloaded.
attendance.adjust.title: Attendance adjustments
attendance.adjust.description: HR adds or subtracts paid minutes of one day for an employee. Every adjustment is recorded with its reason and cannot be edited or deleted; to fix one, add an adjustment of the opposite sign. Possible only while the month's period is open.
attendance.adjust.selfHint: You cannot adjust your own attendance; ask another HR user to do it.
attendance.adjust.closedHint: The period of this month is closed. Reopen it on the Attendance page before adjusting.
attendance.adjust.empty: No adjustment in this month yet.
attendance.adjust.minutesHint: Whole number, negative to subtract, at most 1440 minutes at a time. The month's total cannot go below 0.
attendance.adjust.reasonHint: Keep it short; no personal data or passwords.
attendance.adjust.referenceHint: For example a decision number. Letters, digits and . _ / # : - only
attendance.adjust.formHint: Adjustment for one day of the selected month
attendance.adjust.minutesInvalid: Enter a non-zero number of minutes from -1440 to 1440.
attendance.adjust.reasonRequired: Enter a reason, at most 300 characters.
attendance.adjust.referenceInvalid: The reference may only contain letters, digits and . _ / # : - (at most 64 characters).
attendance.adjust.conflict: Cannot adjust: the day is outside the employee's employment period or the month's total would go below 0. The data shown has been reloaded.
leave.reconciliation.title: Leave reconciliation
leave.reconciliation.description: Pending annual leave requests that, with approved leave, exceed the leave accrued to the end of a month. View only; open a request to decide whether to keep or cancel it.
leave.reconciliation.empty: No pending request exceeds the accrued leave.
report.title: Reports
report.description: Six HR reports within the scope you may see. Closed months come from the stored figures; download the XLSX to get every row of the current filter.
report.error.month: Choose a start and an end month.
report.error.order: The start month must not be after the end month.
report.error.span: The range is at most 12 months.
report.empty: No rows in the scope you may see.
report.export.failedTitle: The file could not be downloaded
report.export.denied: You are not allowed to download this report, or no row falls within your scope.
administration.accounts.title: Account management
administration.accounts.description: Add accounts by email, suspend them or restore their access. Each person signs in with the Google account of the registered email.
administration.accounts.invitation.expir: Cannot sign in yet. Contact the system administrator.
administration.accounts.suspend.title: Suspend this account?
administration.accounts.suspend.body: The user is signed out of every session and cannot sign in until the account is restored.
administration.accounts.restore.title: Restore this account?
administration.accounts.restore.body: The account becomes active again if a Google account is linked, otherwise it waits for the first sign-in. Earlier sessions are not restored; the user must sign in again.
administration.accounts.provision.title: Add an account
administration.accounts.provision.hint: This person signs in with the Google account of exactly this email within 7 days of being added.
administration.accounts.provision.done: Account added. The person has 7 days to sign in with Google for the first time.
setting.title: System settings
setting.description: HR rules and company information. A change applies to actions from the moment it is saved; data already recorded is never rewritten.
setting.readOnly: You can only view this group.
setting.invalid: The value is invalid or outside the allowed range.
setting.conflict: The setting was just changed by someone else or the value is the same. The list has been reloaded; check it and try again.
setting.history.title: Change history
setting.history.empty: No changes yet: the default value is in use.
setting.security.title: Security and sessions
setting.security.description: The values in force, for viewing only. The system sets them and they cannot be changed here.
setting.security.freshAuthenticationSeco: How long a re-authentication (two-step) stays valid for sensitive actions
setting.security.oidcAttemptMinutes: Lifetime of one Google sign-in attempt
setting.security.idleMinutes: Maximum idle time of a session
setting.field.hrAnnualLeaveDefaultMinute: Annual leave minutes recorded for an employee who becomes official (480 minutes = 1 day). Entitlements already recorded do not change.
setting.field.hrWfhMonthLimit.label: Maximum WFH days per month
setting.field.hrWfhMonthLimit.hint: Past this limit the final approver must acknowledge. The WFH report labels over-limit by the value in force, closed months included.
setting.field.hrRequestWindowPastDays.la: Requests may be filed back by up to
setting.field.hrRequestWindowPastDays.hi: Days before today that can still be requested. Requests already filed are not judged again.
Requests may be filed ahead by up to
Days after today that can be requested.
setting.field.hrRequestMaxDays.label: Maximum days per request
setting.field.hrRequestMaxDays.hint: Can only be lowered, at most 31 days.
setting.field.reportMaxMonths.label: Maximum months per report
setting.field.reportMaxMonths.hint: Can only be lowered, at most 12 months.
setting.field.exportMaxRows.label: Maximum rows in an Excel export
setting.field.exportMaxRows.hint: A report with more rows is refused, never cut. Can only be lowered.
setting.field.exportMaxBytes.label: Maximum size of an Excel file
setting.field.exportMaxBytes.hint: In bytes. A larger file is refused. Can only be lowered.
setting.field.companyName.label: Company name
setting.field.companyName.hint: Shown next to the product name inside the app. Leave empty to show the product name only.
setting.field.companyDefaultLocale.label: Default language
setting.field.companyDefaultLocale.hint: Used for people who have not chosen a language.
